sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="auto" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">An animated anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
  <desc id="desc">A cheerful cartoon anteater with a long snout and bushy tail pedals a red unicycle and juggles three colourful bottles under a sunny sky.</desc>

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8ed8ff"/>
      <stop offset="0.65" stop-color="#d9f4ff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff3c9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#b7a086"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#9b8268"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7d6752"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tailGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#a68a68"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#68503e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGrad" cx="0.38" cy="0.35" r="0.8">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff7ae"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#ffd84d"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffab2e"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <clipPath id="bodyClip">
      <ellipse cx="385" cy="272" rx="115" ry="62" transform="rotate(-6 385 272)"/>
    </clipPath>

    <g id="cloudShape">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="48" ry="22" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="-30" cy="7" rx="32" ry="16" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="31" cy="7" rx="36" ry="17" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="2" cy="-14" rx="30" ry="20" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
    </g>

    <!-- One bottle, centred on (0,0); colour is supplied by each instance. -->
    <g id="bottleShape">
      <path d="M-12 22 L-12 -2 Q-12 -10 -5 -16 L-5 -26 L5 -26 L5 -16 Q12 -10 12 -2 L12 22 Q12 28 7 28 L-7 28 Q-12 28 -12 22 Z"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="-35" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#b7793c"/>
      <rect x="-12" y="3" width="24" height="13" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.88"/>
      <path d="M-6 -1 L-6 19" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65" fill="none"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .spin-wheel {
      transform-origin: 400px 435px;
      animation: spin 2s linear infinite;
    }
    .spin-slow {
      transform-origin: 92px 92px;
      animation: spin 26s linear infinite;
    }
    .bob {
      animation: bob 1s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .tail-wag {
      transform-origin: 292px 270px;
      animation: tail 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .head-bob {
      transform-origin: 482px 242px;
      animation: head 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .arm-left {
      transform-origin: 360px 278px;
      animation: armLeft 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .arm-right {
      transform-origin: 456px 280px;
      animation: armRight 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .tumble {
      transform-box: fill-box;
      transform-origin: center;
      animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
    }
    .speed {
      animation: speed 0.65s linear infinite;
    }
    .tongue {
      transform-origin: 613px 265px;
      animation: tongue 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .twinkle {
      transform-box: fill-box;
      transform-origin: center;
      animation: twinkle 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .twinkle.two { animation-delay: -0.45s; }
    .twinkle.three { animation-delay: -0.9s; }

    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes bob {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
    }
    @keyframes tail {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-2deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(4deg); }
    }
    @keyframes head {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-1.5deg) translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: rotate(2deg) translateY(-2px); }
    }
    @keyframes armLeft {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(3deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(-5deg) translateY(-3px); }
    }
    @keyframes armRight {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-5deg) translateY(-3px); }
      50% { transform: rotate(3deg); }
    }
    @keyframes speed { to { transform: translateX(-120px); } }
    @keyframes tongue {
      0%, 68%, 100% { transform: scaleX(0.15) rotate(4deg); opacity: 0; }
      78%, 88% { transform: scaleX(1) rotate(4deg); opacity: 1; }
    }
    @keyframes twinkle {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(0.55) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0.25; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.15) rotate(25deg); opacity: 1; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <g class="spin-slow" stroke="#ffb52e" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8">
    <line x1="92" y1="18" x2="92" y2="36"/>
    <line x1="92" y1="148" x2="92" y2="166"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="92" x2="36" y2="92"/>
    <line x1="148" y1="92" x2="166" y2="92"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="40" x2="52" y2="52"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="132" x2="144" y2="144"/>
    <line x1="144" y1="40" x2="132" y2="52"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="132" x2="40" y2="144"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="92" cy="92" r="38" fill="url(#sunGrad)" stroke="#ff9f1c" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="88" r="4" fill="#8a5a00"/>
  <circle cx="104" cy="88" r="4" fill="#8a5a00"/>
  <path d="M79 102 Q92 112 105 102" fill="none" stroke="#8a5a00" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Drifting clouds -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-180 72" to="920 72" dur="46s" begin="-12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <use href="#cloudShape"/>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.75">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-240 135" to="940 135" dur="64s" begin="-38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="scale(0.68)"><use href="#cloudShape"/></g>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.85">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-160 48" to="920 48" dur="55s" begin="-44s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="scale(0.5)"><use href="#cloudShape"/></g>
  </g>

  <!-- Distant hills and ground -->
  <path d="M0 470 Q130 385 275 465 T560 450 T800 462 L800 530 L0 530 Z" fill="#9bdd8a"/>
  <path d="M0 492 Q170 430 360 485 T800 482 L800 535 L0 535 Z" fill="#6fca72"/>
  <rect y="518" width="800" height="82" fill="#68707c"/>
  <rect y="518" width="800" height="10" fill="#8b95a1"/>
  <g class="speed" stroke="#f7e58b" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="-90" y1="562" x2="-25" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="562" x2="95" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="562" x2="215" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="270" y1="562" x2="335" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="562" x2="455" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="510" y1="562" x2="575" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="630" y1="562" x2="695" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="750" y1="562" x2="815" y2="562"/>
    <line x1="870" y1="562" x2="935" y2="562"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Wheel shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="526" rx="105" ry="11" fill="#30343a" opacity="0.25">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="105;96;105" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.18;0.25" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>

  <!-- Unicycle wheel -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="435" r="82" fill="#eef7ff" stroke="#263238" stroke-width="17"/>
  <circle cx="400" cy="435" r="68" fill="none" stroke="#90a4ae" stroke-width="4"/>
  <g class="spin-wheel">
    <g stroke="#78909c" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="400" y2="368"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="447" y2="388"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="467" y2="435"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="447" y2="482"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="400" y2="502"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="353" y2="482"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="333" y2="435"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="353" y2="388"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Cranks and pedals, synchronised with the animated feet below. -->
    <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="434" y2="435" stroke="#37474f" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="400" y1="435" x2="366" y2="435" stroke="#37474f" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="424" y="428" width="30" height="11" rx="5" fill="#263238"/>
    <rect x="346" y="428" width="30" height="11" rx="5" fill="#263238"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="400" cy="435" r="14" fill="#ffb300" stroke="#37474f" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- Fork and saddle -->
  <path d="M382 335 C378 380 386 410 400 435 C414 410 422 380 418 335" fill="none" stroke="#d8434f" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="400" y1="338" x2="400" y2="312" stroke="#546e7a" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M365 312 Q400 295 436 312 Q430 326 400 324 Q370 326 365 312 Z" fill="#3e2723"/>

  <!-- Rider -->
  <g class="bob">
    <!-- Bushy tail -->
    <g class="tail-wag">
      <path d="M294 248 C225 174 132 166 96 219 C63 267 83 318 142 331 C205 345 268 318 298 287 C286 274 282 262 294 248 Z" fill="url(#tailGrad)"/>
      <path d="M276 258 C220 207 158 198 126 229 C101 254 111 292 151 301 C198 311 249 291 276 270" fill="none" stroke="#c9ad8b" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>
      <path d="M250 231 C215 210 176 207 151 220 M258 281 C222 301 180 303 151 288" stroke="#5d4635" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Far leg: starts half a pedal-turn behind the near leg. -->
    <path fill="none" stroke="#6f5946" stroke-width="19" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M355 310 L382 365 L366 435">
      <animate attributeName="d" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="
        M355 310 L382 365 L366 435;
